name: a-newer-signal-sent-elsewhere-cuts-the-older-work
description: A sender's newer signal makes its older one stale wherever the older one went (5.4): `r` first forwards to `a` alone, then, for a newer input with the same key, to `b` alone. No signal reaches `a` again, and its running call is cut all the same: a key reaches every outgoing link of its sender.
